title: QEMU start failure performs verified reverse cleanup or quarantines
blocker: The repository has isolated VFIO-provider and QMP-gate component premises, but no production launcher/controller transaction proves fd, IOAS, DMA, IRQ, reset, driver and lease cleanup after failures at every QEMU spawn/readiness/realization boundary. Component success is not end-to-end product closure.
assertions: QEMU receives only inherited admitted fds and cannot reopen a host BDF during cleanup
failure before QMP ready or topology verification executes the complete compensation stack in reverse order
DMA maps, IRQ eventfds, IOAS attachment, VFIO fds and driver ownership are independently read back before release
any uncertain teardown or reset result preserves the durable whole-bundle claim in quarantine
